title: OwnerTransferRequest
description: Transfer ownership of a collection to another user (POST /v1/collections/{id}/owner body). Ownership is transferred, never granted: there is exactly one active owner row per collection, so the handover is an atomic revoke+grant pair rather than an extra share. The subject takes the same vocabulary as a share grantee, minus the group forms.

subject.description: The new owner. A value containing ':' is a full 'issuer:subject' string kept verbatim; the form '@service:<subject>' names a SERVICE ACCOUNT and keeps its subject colon-free; a bare BV-BRC username is prefixed to 'bvbrc:<username>'. The group forms ('@public', '@group:<id>') parse but are rejected with 400 — ownership is grantable to users only, never to a group. The resolved subject is echoed back as 'owner' so a typo is visible before it becomes an unreachable collection.

issuer.description: Issuer used to qualify a bare username (default 'bvbrc'). Ignored for '@service:' and for a value that already contains ':'.
